meta.name: Mexico
meta.blurb: Seven fronts from Alta California to Costa Rica. Restore the empire of the Three Guarantees.
meta.pitch: a 1936 grand-strategy war map of Mexico
meta.capitalFalls: The government withdraws to Querétaro. The war goes on.
meta.capitalFreed: Mexico City is free again. The government returns to the National Palace.

landmarks.desc: Reach Santa Fe, the northern end of the Camino Real de Tierra Adentro

days.text: ¡Viva México! Independence Day on every front.
Cinco de Mayo. Puebla held in 1862; the line holds today.
Día de la Bandera. The tricolour of Iguala flies over every front.
Revolution Day. The army parades through the Zócalo.

meta.motto: Religión, Independencia, Unión — the Three Guarantees of Iguala, 1821.
